description: This file defines synchronization utilities for API locking, including thread-local flags, lock management templates, and registration functions for API methods, primarily used for thread-safe plugin communication in a C++ project.

classes.name: ApiLocks
classes.description: Keeps API locks, one per specific class, using static recursive_mutex.

classes.name: UnlockApiGuard
classes.description: Guard that unlocks and re-locks the API mutex to prevent deadlocks during plugin calls.

classes.name: LockApiGuard
classes.description: Guard that manages locking and unlocking of the API mutex.

methods.name: getFunctionToCall
methods.description: Creates a std::function wrapper around a method call, managing locking and thread-local flags.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApi
methods.description: Registers a method with the JSONRPC plugin system with locking.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForVersions
methods.description: Registers a method with version support.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForHandler
methods.description: Registers a method with a JSONRPC handler.
